body.description: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean outline, detailed shading. One item only, it fills most of the square, transparent background. Each item stays fully inside its own square and does not touch the edges. No pedestal, no stand, no display base, no plate, no text, no letters, no numbers, no extra objects.
item_descriptions: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean dark outline around the whole object, detailed shading. a very long, pencil-thin syringe-shaped specimen collector, tilted diagonally from lower left to upper right, the body is eight times longer than it is wide, the body is only about 9 to 10 pixels wide, a thin glass tube wrapped by slim blue-steel metal strips along both sides, with tiny tick marks, a small flared metal cap at the top with a small round ring loop, thin metal collars at both ends, a short thin needle-like nozzle at the bottom. The metal parts are always the same plain cool blue-steel grey, never gold or yellow, the color and light belong only to the liquid. The glass tube is completely empty and transparent, clear pale glass with thin white reflections, nothing inside, not dark. Only this item, nothing else beside it, no text, no halo or glow outside the object's outline, fully inside its square.
